Subject: SparkFlow trial: success criteria, handoff & weekly check-ins

Hi Aisha / Liam — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move to a short trial with clear evaluation gates.

High-level objective
- Validate Redwood inference for SparkFlow's customer support triage pipeline: intent classification + priority reranking at 75ms p99 target under your expected concurrency.

Proposed success criteria (draft)
- Latency: p95 < 50ms, p99 < 120ms on the 1k concurrent session profile you shared.
- Accuracy: intent classification F1 >= 0.87 on the sample labeled set; priority rerank NDCG@5 >= 0.82.
- Cost target: projected token cost < $0.007 per support request after batching & caching.
- Operational: rollout script + automatic fallback to smaller model if p99 > 200ms for >5 minutes.

Trial plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): sign MOA and share a 1-week data slice + access to test cluster. (Attachments: trial plan + success criteria)
- Week 1: baseline runs & tuning, initial metrics snapshot.
- Week 2: focused model configuration and failover testing.
- Week 3: final evaluation and written readout.

Owners / asks
- SparkFlow: share the sample dataset and a list of peak hours by EOD Wed — Aisha.
- Redwood: configuration & baseline run — Jordan (I'll own the run and capture metrics).
- CS/Scale: integration assist + monitoring config — Marissa.

Attachments: sparkflow_trial-plan-v1.pdf, sparkflow_success-criteria.xlsx. Please review and confirm by EOD Wed if that timeline looks reasonable. If agreed I'll send a scoped MOA for signature.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0192

Jordan — thanks for the summary and the draft criteria. Quick answers below and a small tweak to the acceptance window.

Confirmations/changes
- We can provide a 2-week sample dataset, anonymized, by Wed EOD (I'll drop a link).
- Latency targets: we can stretch to p99 < 150ms for the trial; production target is tighter but want to allow room for tuning.
- Accuracy targets are fine; we'll validate labels on our side and flag any class imbalance.
- Cost: budget team wants a forecast if we exceed $0.010 per request. Can you include that scenario in the readout?

Timeline: Wed dataset -> baseline run Fri -> follow-ups next week. MOA — please send the scoped doc; we'll try to sign within 48 hours of receipt.
